summary:
Saudi Arabia has suspended flights after a deadly Houthi attack on an airport, the latest in a weekend of confrontation with the Houthis in Yemen. Saudi authorities said they were fending off drone and missile attacks, and Iran, which backs the Houthis, offered to mediate.

The United States has suspended sanctions on Russian diesel, a decision that stunned Ukrainian and European officials, and Ukraine has called it a gift to President Putin. Zelensky says six Ukrainian energy sites have been hit since Trump announced an energy ceasefire, although Ukraine has halted strikes on Russian oil refineries for two days.

A cyberattack remotely altered refrigeration temperatures in hundreds of French supermarkets, spoiling large quantities of fresh and frozen food. The attack targeted a Danish software system used in at least 380 stores, and the attackers have not been identified. Pope Leo XIV was admitted to Rome's Gemelli hospital on Tuesday for surgery to remove a small lung nodule found at an early stage.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia suspends flights after deadly Houthi attack on airport
headlines.summary: Saudi Arabia has suspended all flights to and from one of its main airports after a Houthi attack that killed people. Saudi authorities said they were fending off drone and missile attacks following a weekend of fighting with the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen.

headlines.title: Trump suspends sanctions on Russian diesel, drawing criticism
headlines.summary: President Trump suspended sanctions on Russian diesel fuel, a decision that stunned Ukrainian and European officials. Ukraine has called the move a gift to President Putin, and US lawmakers have questioned whether the deal is legal.

headlines.title: Russia keeps striking Ukrainian energy sites despite Trump ceasefire
headlines.summary: Zelensky says six Ukrainian energy sites have been hit since Trump announced that energy infrastructure would not be targeted. Zelensky also says Ukraine has halted strikes on Russian oil refineries for two days.

headlines.title: Cyberattack alters fridge temperatures in hundreds of French supermarkets
headlines.summary: A cyberattack remotely changed the temperatures of refrigerators in hundreds of French supermarkets, spoiling fresh and frozen food. The attack targeted a Danish software system used in at least 380 stores, and the attackers have not been identified.

headlines.title: Drone strikes sink merchant ship off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast
headlines.summary: Drones struck ships off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast, sinking a merchant ship with eleven crew members missing, local officials said. Bulgaria has summoned the Russian ambassador, and the prime minister said two ships were hit.

headlines.title: Pope Leo admitted to hospital for surgery to remove lung nodule
headlines.summary: Pope Leo XIV was admitted to Rome's Gemelli hospital on Tuesday for surgery to remove a small lung nodule found at an early stage. The Vatican said the surgery is low risk and the pontiff is expected to spend about a week recovering.

headlines.title: Federal agents search Representative Ilhan Omar's Washington home
headlines.summary: US immigration authorities raided the Washington home of Democratic Representative Ilhan Omar on Monday as part of an ongoing investigation into alleged immigration fraud. The probe reportedly includes immigration paperwork completed by her late father.

headlines.title: EU to cap hybrid vehicle imports from China at 350,000 a year
headlines.summary: The EU will restrict hybrid electric vehicle imports from China to 350,000 units a year, using WTO rules to impose the quota quickly. The measure is intended to halve China's projected shipments to the bloc and cut its market share to 3%.
